page.content:
Arthur's court and the seat of the Round Table.

How Camelot connects

  • Character: King Arthur — Arthur holds court at Camelot.
  • Faction: Round Table — The Round Table sits in Arthur's hall at Camelot.
  • Event: Grail Quest — The Quest is proclaimed when the Grail appears at Camelot.

What is Camelot?

Camelot is the legendary capital where Arthur holds court, knights take the Pentecost feast, and the fellowship of the Table gathers before it breaks over Guinevere and the Grail.

Key threads lead to King Arthur, Round Table and Grail Quest.
